title: Stand up Cowork / Copilot Credits reporting
summary: Get Cowork / Work IQ credit consumption and cost into Power BI. Start on sample data in ~10 minutes; wire up your own tenant when you're ready. Cowork totals work for everyone — department and per-person views need one extra admin switch.

paths.label: Local CSV
paths.tagline: ~10 minutes · Power BI Pro · no Fabric capacity
paths.bestWhen: You want to see it working today.

paths.label: Fabric
paths.bestWhen: You want it refreshing weekly on its own.

paths.label: Viva Direct
paths.bestWhen: You want Cowork data with no files at all.

steps.title: See what you're building
steps.body: Two minutes here saves an hour later. This is the finished report running on sample data — credit consumption, cost, spending-policy budgets and a forecast for Cowork / Work IQ.

steps.title: Try it on sample data first
steps.body: Before touching your tenant, run the Local CSV path against the bundled synthetic dataset. It proves the numbers are worth automating and needs no permissions at all.
steps.verify: The report opens with every Cowork page populated from synthetic data.

steps.title: Turn on Viva identification
steps.body: Viva Insights ships Copilot data de-identified — the person arrives as a hashed PersonId. Cowork totals and cost are correct either way, but department, cost-centre, manager and per-person views need this on. Create a policy: App Viva Insights, Feature Identification, Access On. Not retroactive — only exports taken after the policy carry real UPNs.

portal.label: M365 admin center → Feature access management

steps.verify: Wait up to 24h, re-run your export; the person column shows UserPrincipalName, not a hash.
steps.pitfall: It is not retroactive — existing exports keep their hashes; only new runs are identified.

ifMissing.message: You need Global Administrator or AI Administrator to turn identification on, and you don't hold either. Without it you still get Cowork totals and cost — just not department or per-person breakdowns.
ifMissing.emailSubject: 2-minute admin task: turn on Viva identification for Copilot cost reporting
ifMissing.emailBody:
Hi,

I'm standing up Cowork / Copilot credit reporting and need identification turned on in Viva Insights so we can break spend down by department. It's a ~2 minute change and only a Global Admin or AI Admin can do it:

1. Go to https://admin.cloud.microsoft/?#/viva/featureAccessManagement
2. Settings > Viva > Feature access management
3. Create a policy: App = Viva Insights, Feature = Identification, Access = On (everyone, or a named analyst group)
4. It takes up to 24 hours to apply, and only affects exports taken after it's on.

Note: this processes personal data, so please apply whatever privacy/works-council review we normally would.

Thanks!

steps.title: Build the Cowork credit query in Viva
steps.body: In Viva Insights → Analysis, build a custom query with the Copilot credit metrics. For the self-refreshing paths, turn on Auto-refresh and copy the Partition + Query identifiers from Analysis results.
steps.verify: The query returns rows with credit metrics and, if identification is on, a UserPrincipalName column.
steps.pitfall: Leave the GitHub Copilot credit metric out — it makes the Cowork query fail in Viva before Power BI is even involved.

ifMissing.message: Building a Viva query needs the Viva Insights Analyst role, which is assigned inside Viva (not Entra), so we can't auto-detect it. If you don't have it, an admin assigns it in the Viva Insights admin experience.
ifMissing.emailSubject: Please assign me the Viva Insights Analyst role
ifMissing.emailBody:
Hi,

To build the Copilot credit query for our cost reporting I need the Viva Insights Analyst role. Assignment steps are here: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/assign-user-roles

Thanks!

steps.title: Open the Local CSV template
steps.body: Download your Viva export, drop it in a folder, open Consumption Central - Local CSV.pbit, paste the folder path into DataFolder, click Load.
steps.verify: The Cowork pages fill in from your own export.

steps.title: Open the Viva Direct template
steps.body: Paste the Partition + Query identifiers from your auto-refreshing query into Consumption Central - Viva Direct.pbit and click Load — no files at all.
steps.verify: The report refreshes straight from Viva with no download.
steps.pitfall: If it returns (500) Internal Server Error, your identifiers point at the multi-table Consumption Dashboard export instead of a custom Analysis query.
